# `aitbc dispute evidence verify`

Verify or reject a piece of evidence (arbitrators only).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute evidence verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dispute-id` | integer | — | yes | Dispute the evidence belongs to. |
| `--evidence-id` | integer | — | yes | Evidence entry to rule on. |
| `--reject` | flag | `false` | no | Mark the evidence as not verified instead of verified. |
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute evidence verify --dispute-id <dispute_id> --evidence-id <evidence_id>
```
